meta.name: Pacific Rim The Black
meta.description: Two siblings - an idealistic teenage boy and his naive younger sister - are forced to pilot an abandoned Jaeger across a hostile landscape in a desperate attempt to find their missing parents.

videos.title: From the Shadows
videos.overview: Five years after their parents left to find help, siblings Taylor and Hayley find a training Jaeger - but it quickly attracts a Kaiju to their village.

videos.title: Into the Black
videos.overview: When Atlas Destroyer runs out of energy, Taylor and Hayley search a nearby destroyed city for power cells and make some startling discoveries.

videos.title: Bogan
videos.overview: While on foot, Taylor, Hayley and Boy encounter a mobile settlement that traffics in Kaiju body parts.  Its shady leader seeks to uncover their secret.

videos.title: Up and Running
videos.overview: When a Kaiju fast approaches, Shane forces Taylor to copilot Atlas Destroyer with Mei to get it out of harm's way, but Taylor wants to fight.

videos.title: Escaping Bogan
videos.overview: To take back Atlas Destroyer and save Hayley and Boy, Taylor attempts a risky maneuverer known as "ghost piloting."  Joel and Mei make a deadly choice.

videos.title: Boneyard
videos.overview: The mystery behind Boy's past deepens when Taylor and Hayley find him among dead Kaiju and destroyed Jaegers - along with the creature responsible.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: While responding to a distress signal, Taylor and Hayley find their parents' abandoned Jaeger and confront the Kaiju that attacked their village.

videos.title: bOy
videos.overview: Boy's transformation into a Kaiju alarms Taylor and Mei, but Hayley wants to keep caring for him. A group of mysterious women attempts to kidnap Boy.

videos.title: The Never Never
videos.overview: With Boy gravely injured, Hayley, Taylor and Mei pilot the Jaeger toward a valley full of Kaiju, where a supposed Kaiju whisperer might be able to help.

videos.title: Divide
videos.overview: The Atlas Destroyer gets chased into the territory of the Sisters of the Kaiju, where Hayley, Taylor and Mei argue about what should be done with Boy.

videos.title: Sisters of the Kaiju
videos.overview: After successfully catching up with the Atlas Destroyer, Shane offers Hayley and Taylor a trade: the Jaeger for something they desperately want.

videos.title: Mind, Body, Soul
videos.overview: As Hayley and Taylor's mother tries to resist the High Priestess, the group plots to rescue Boy before his mind is permanently turned against them.

videos.title: The Twilight Run
videos.overview: When Boy falls under the spell of the Sisters and transforms into a Kaiju bent on destroying the Atlas Destroyer, a surprising ally comes to its aid.

videos.title: Final Approach
videos.overview: With creatures close behind, Hayley, Taylor, Mei and Boy race to the safety of Sydney Base, but the Sisters call upon a Category VI Kaiju to stop them.

meta.slogan: The only way home is through the Black.
